summary: Enhance your skills in biodiversity conservation and community engagement with our comprehensive NGO training course. Join us to make a real impact!
lede: Biodiversity conservation and community engagement training helps NGO teams assess ecological priorities and plan participation in conservation projects. For NGO program managers, conservation officers, community liaison staff and monitoring specialists, it supports practical work on biodiversity baselines and indicators, stakeholder mapping, participatory engagement, safeguard planning and evidence-based results reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage biodiversity work, coordinate community relationships, and report conservation outcomes in NGO settings.
prerequisites: Intermediate familiarity with NGO programme delivery, community engagement, or environmental project work is recommended. You should be able to read basic project documents, contribute to field planning, and interpret simple monitoring data. Prior exposure to biodiversity projects, stakeholder consultations, or environmental safeguards is helpful but not mandatory. No coding is required; if digital mapping or spreadsheet-based exercises are used, the course provides guided templates and hands-on support.
